# Company Losses

<!-- In this section we will discuss how to accurately report Company losses on a financial disclosure. In financial disclosures, we want to be as conservative as possible. This means that we want to take into account all possible risks and uncertainties, as well as any potential future losses. This will ensure that investors are fully informed and are able to make an informed decision about whether or not to invest in the company. -->
